_doc: Post-extraction triage configuration (Track Q, Part A). One-time, version-controlled, decoupled from the pipeline logic. Edit this file to change tiering — the pipeline reads it, never re-asks.

kg_goal.note: Themes (BeleidsThema/BeleidsPijler) are the primary navigation lens. Actors are deliberately LIMITED (initially) to ministries, regions, and programmes — incl. RegioDeal and named programmes like NOVEX as programme-level actors. Indicators/metrics and loose amounts are detail (reference), NOT core.

relation_predicates.note: Structural predicates form the KG backbone and count toward connectivity (degree). VERSTERKT/VERMINDERT are meaningful thematic edges → structural (operator-confirmed). RELATED is the weak/generic edge → flagged by the backbone-check, does NOT count toward structural connectivity. Unmapped predicates default to weak (don't assume an unknown predicate is backbone).

status_rules._note: How tier x degree maps to status in the per-run pipeline (B4/B5). Degree = count of STRUCTURAL relations (weak/RELATED edges excluded). The pipeline may also report total degree separately, but the active/reference decision uses structural degree.
rules: active-tier type AND degree == 0            -> active, BUT review-queue: 'isolated core actor / possible extraction gap'
reference-tier type AND degree >= 3         -> reference, BUT review-queue: 'candidate active'
unsure_review-tier type                      -> reference by default, ALWAYS review-queue: 'unsure — operator decides'
manual_override == true                      -> keep operator status, automation NEVER overwrites
